notes.title: Backroom Company Dev Log #01
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Backroom Company development team.  
As promised in the previous roadmap, we are carefully identifying shortcomings and working step by step to improve them.  

First of all, we would like to share the news about new entities and reworked existing entities, which many of you have been waiting for. With this update, the gameplay experience provided by each entity will change significantly.  

Below we are revealing the appearance of the new entities in advance. (The final version may differ slightly.)  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/334149597cce86978b88a2df9cb054f90693454d.png  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/653173b239dbe7050279fa3d111a0cb724858e26.png  

The new entities will appear in harmony with the atmosphere of specific sections and are designed to create tension in a variety of ways, beyond simple chases.  

Next, we would like to introduce the main rework items currently in progress besides the entities.  

Requirements DOWN, Quality UP  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png  

1. Performance & Graphic Improvements  

In the past, the exploration phase was completely randomly generated, which made us heavily rely on Unreal Engine’s latest lighting technology, “Lumen.”  
Lumen calculates light in real time and, while it can provide stunning visuals in theory, in practice it consumes a lot of PC performance.  

As a result:  
  
 On PCs with medium or lower settings, as well as on Radeon and GTX graphics cards, the image quality degraded, forcing play in low quality.  
 Even on PCs with recommended specifications, occasional crashes or FPS drops occurred.   

Through this rework, the map structure has been improved, allowing us to apply Light Bake.  
Light Bake precomputes the game’s light and shadows and stores them, so the PC no longer needs to perform heavy calculations in real time during play.  

In other words, graphics quality will be further improved and game stability will be greatly enhanced, and you will be able to experience this very soon.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png  

2. Complete Rework of the Exploration Phase  

The original exploration phase was structured so that rooms were connected completely at random.  
However, this approach made it difficult to deliver the intended gameplay experience, and players’ satisfaction remained low.  

In this rework, we have completely redesigned the structure while preserving the core of the exploration phase – randomness, so that each exploration offers a fresh experience.  
Through this, we can convey the gameplay more clearly and have applied the following changes.  

1) Entity Patrols  
Entities no longer move completely at random but patrol designated rooms or a set range.  
This allows for more intentional tension.  

2) Entity Spawns  
Previously, entities spawned randomly or near the player.  
Now they appear at predetermined spawn points suited to the nature of each room.  
This creates harmony between section concepts and background art, expanding tension beyond simple pursuit.  

3) Addition of Sub-Missions  
Instead of simply collecting and selling scraps, each exploration phase now includes unique random missions.  
Examples include reaching a specific room to complete a mini-game or photographing a one-of-a-kind anomaly on the map—challenges designed in a High Risk, High Return format.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png  

3. Partial Rework of Story Levels  

Some mini-games in story levels lacked clear rule explanations or did not match the distinctive Backroom atmosphere.  
We are now focusing on the core concept of exploring horror and the unknown, while also expanding content through these reworks.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png  

These are large-scale updates that take considerable time.  
However, to show our progress as soon as possible and gather feedback, we plan to launch open betas as each level rework is completed.  
For example: when the hotel is finished, the hotel will open; when the swimming pool is finished, the swimming pool will open.  

Details on the open beta schedule and participation will be announced later through Steam and Discord.  
We will continue to share our progress and reflect your valuable feedback.  

Join the Official Discord  
Visit the Steam Store Page  

Thank you.  
The Backroom Company Development Team

notes.title: 🚪 Backroom Company Long-Term Roadmap Revealed 🗺️
notes.content:
[color=#8ab4ff]Long-Term Roadmap After Official Launch[/color]
[color=#9aa0a6]#EnhancedImmersion  #MechanicsFocusedGameplay  #ContentExpansion  #Stabilization[/color]

 Hello, explorers. This is the Backroom Company development team.

First of all, we sincerely thank everyone who has looked forward to and played our game.
Due to the short development period and limited resources, we are aware that we have not been able to fully meet the expectations many of you had.
We sincerely apologize to those who may have felt disappointed or unsatisfied.

Since launch, we have been carefully reviewing every piece of feedback received through the community and various channels, while also conducting an internal analysis of the game’s current issues.
In particular, we recognize the following as key areas for improvement: ▲Lack of creatures with diverse mechanics, ▲Monotony and reduced immersion in story levels, ▲Insufficient stability and optimization.

Our team aims to address these issues not just with short-term fixes, but through a clear, long-term roadmap.
We will continue to listen to the voices of our players to make Backroom Company more fun, richer in content, and higher in quality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png

[color=#a78bfa]New Stages Planned[/color] 

 Arcade
 Barn
 Abandoned sheet metal factory
 Playroom

 Developer Comment
This new stage will be placed before the ending stage, with one set to be released in the second half of the year. The theme or atmosphere may change during development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[color=#a78bfa]Story Rework[/color]

In the new story rework, players will experience greater immersion from the moment they first set foot in the stage, with enhanced presentation and environmental changes.
Clues about important characters and events will be revealed subtly, allowing players to gradually approach the truth.
Additionally, rather than relying solely on cutscenes, player choices and interactions will directly influence the story’s progression, ensuring that the narrative and gameplay blend naturally.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[color=#a78bfa]New Creatures & Reworks[/color]

○ Existing Creature Remakes

 Map-themed creature “Partygoer” — 3 pattern remakes
 Creature “Moth” — remake
 Creature “Ms. Helena” — remake

○ New Creatures

 Codename '[color=#f28b82]Game Master[/color]'
 Codename '[color=#f28b82]The One Who Slips into the Shadows[/color]'

 Developer Comment
Based on feedback from explorers, we are reviewing the patterns and interaction methods of existing creatures.
Going forward, we aim to deliver gameplay that combines more unique mechanics with strategic decision-making, allowing each creature to have its own personality and be fun to face.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[color=#a78bfa]Story Stage Improvements[/color]

Key story maps such as “Hotel,” “Pool,” and “Parking Lot” will be expanded while maintaining their original atmosphere and flow, refining the connection between gameplay and mechanics for a more natural experience.
Rather than complete replacements, these updates will be upgrades that preserve both familiarity and immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[color=#a78bfa]System Updates[/color]

 Leaderboard system — [color=#8ab4ff]Early September[/color]
 Card collection system

○ New Farming System & Hidden Dungeons

In addition to collecting relics and purchasing shop items, we are preparing a system that allows players to acquire resources in more diverse ways.  
In particular, with the new [color=#f28b82]True Noclip system[/color], approaching a “wavy wall” will naturally lead to entry into a [color=#f28b82]hidden dungeon[/color].  
This dungeon will be designed as a high-risk, high-reward structure, offering both significant challenges and valuable rewards.  
We will also expand the [color=#f28b82]use of relays[/color] to provide more strategic gameplay options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[color=#a78bfa]Optimization · Hotfixes[/color]

 Significant ambiance improvements — [color=#8ab4ff]August[/color]
 Continuous performance optimization & bug fixes — [color=#8ab4ff]Always![/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png

Backroom Company will continue to listen to player feedback and deliver experiences with unique mechanics and strong immersion.

Thank you.

notes.title: Major Story Update Announcement: Research Takes a New Turn
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/9cbd21fb1f6d3f4b6fd00c2411b6f4115b697e12.png

Greetings. I am Blagos, a mid-level manager at Async Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Backroom Company).
My focus is on evaluating your research performance and eliminating unnecessary resources that hinder efficiency.
Today, along with the expansion of the Backroom universe, I am here to announce an update that will introduce new chaos and challenges for you.
Review the provided information carefully and refrain from asking unnecessary questions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png

Major Story Update Announcement

In mid-March 2025, Backroom Company's research will enter a new phase.
Your role remains simple: carry out the assigned tasks and provide data. Anything beyond that is neither expected nor necessary.

This story update is designed to make your 'work environment' a little more 'engaging and immersive.'
After all, it’s merely a mechanism to ensure you continue contributing to experiments for a longer period.

Following the update, you will experience a story that unfolds alongside new events in each stage.
Your small actions will play a part in completing the bigger picture of what is happening in Backroom Company.
Of course, always remember that your choices are nothing more than carefully controlled variables in the grand scheme of things.

Prepare yourselves. The new stage is about to begin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png

Key Features of the Major Story Update

[The Hub]
The existing lobby has been completely redesigned and will be introduced as 'The Hub.'

"No more outdated and inefficient lobbies. This space, restructured as a temporary research facility within a tunnel, provides you with the perfect environment to conduct research."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/a385c4f319a5da4a8cdce437f20c5a1681c54cca.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d3067cef71d64500607ee9713e24139bf447a09e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[Unique Trailers]
When entering a new stage, a unique trailer will play for each one.

"Before entering a stage, you will select it on the monitor and then travel via elevator.
While the elevator ascends, take a moment to enjoy the transition into a new environment.
That brief moment will be the only respite you have left."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/8acc2d9987215bd42661a6df4140caec6c3c4258.png
"Oh dear, the elevator seems to have stopped due to an unforeseen accident.
Of course, that would only be unexpected from your perspective."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[Story-Specific Map System]
 New fixed story-specific maps will be added.
 Each stage will include various puzzle elements such as hidden object searches, quizzes, and mini-games.
 The stages are designed with unique spaces tailored to the environment, and reaching 'The Hub' will count as clearing the stage.
 Each story map is available only on the first entry and will be excluded upon re-entry after completion.

"Fixed maps, huh... Looks like you'll have to navigate on your own instead of relying on randomness.
Even if the maps become larger and more complex, all you need is simple judgment and execution.

Just reach your destination. Nothing more is required, so you shouldn’t feel too burdened."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/d02ce1ec85ad39de3e9f8963e27e9372a8aa9d8d.png

[Unique Story Updates]
"Through this story update, you will get a deeper glimpse into parts of Backroom Company.
Of course, whether that information holds any significance for you is irrelevant.

The story is merely another mechanism to keep you moving.
Whatever you may feel along the way, never forget that the only thing that truly matters is leaving behind data."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048333/76d815d4256c8d1dd58158c642d652e57c61731c.png

Research must always be challenging.
Ensuring that you endure the process is simply part of my job.

I’ll see you in the next experiment.
Good luck. If you need it.

 The previously simple entrance will be greatly expanded to enhance the mysterious atmosphere of the Backroom.
